summary: Cuprina Holdings (Cayman) Limited furnished a Form 6-K containing notice of an extraordinary general meeting scheduled for October 15, 2026, with a record date of September 8, 2026. Shareholders will vote on increasing authorised share capital from US$100,000 (12,500,000 shares of US$0.008 par, split equally Class A and Class B) to US$10,000,000 (1,250,000,000 shares), adopting a Third Amended and Restated Memorandum and Articles of Association lowering the written-resolution threshold to a simple majority, and an adjournment proposal. The board unanimously recommends voting FOR all items. This is a routine capital-structure housekeeping matter, not a special situation.
